language_policy: Arabic and French are equally admissible; language never changes evidentiary rank.
archive_policy: Archives of an allowed domain are transport evidence only. The original domain, original publication date, capture date and content hash must be preserved.
historical_article_update_rule: A live page published before cutoff but updated after cutoff is not automatically admissible. Use a pre-cutoff archive, a versioned static asset, or reject any section whose pre-cutoff existence cannot be established.
search_snippet_rule: Search snippets are discovery only and never evidence.
outcome_source_separation: Pages or files containing target-election results, elected-member lists, victory/defeat language or post-election analyses are held in the sealed outcome partition and excluded from packet construction.
new_source_rule: No new source class may be added during execution. A new domain is usable only if it objectively fits T0 or T1 and its qualification is logged before extraction.
